column1: # Diet method foods (diet-food-words/1): the words that are the whole food name of uncurated foods recipe lines are linked to, derived from the corpus, never listed by hand (review ck16-2 of staging checkpoint 7, S4). A book method that names one where no line of its recipe carries it names a food the lines lost, so a severe type holds the recipe as unknown (133979 Poularde Valencienne: "a garnish of rizotto"); a word a curated food knows is read by its class instead.

# Derivation, on the read-only staging copy of 2026-11-25: every live food that is not curated or rejected and that recipe lines are linked to, whose name read by DietFoodWords.MethodWords (food words without line words and the method skips) is one word; kept when the lines of at least 2 distinct recipes are on such foods and those recipes are at least one tenth of the recipes whose method names the word. A word no curated food knows is read as a food in a method only at one fifth (DietFoodWords.MethodFoodShare; below it a word methods use far more than lines list is a tool or a thing the recipe makes: pan, oven, cloth, paper, crust, icing, filling, stuffing, liquor, dripping, ice), a word of a description's second part that the catalog already flags at one tenth (cider).
# foods: the uncurated foods of that name; recipes: the distinct recipes whose lines are on them; methods: the recipes whose method names the word.
